title: dacryodes ferruginea
intro: Dacryodes ferruginea, commonly known as the Red Ironwood, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dacryodes ferruginea include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's therapeutic efficacy and make it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
